title: MyATM
description: Simple mod that add Game-to-Site connected debit cards and Terminals for in-game payment.
body:
### Attention!
- Works only with sites that has MyATM support.
- You can find example of that type of sites [here](https://github.com/RealDodik/ExampleBank_For_MyATM).
- License - MIT
- You can get help or send bug reports on [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/NBshcdFrWQ) 

### How to Setup:
- Run your site with MyATM support.
- Put MyATM.jar into the "mods" folder.
- Run the game and enter the world.
- Put your bank_name, site_link and api_password (Check README in example site), from site to - myATM.cfg (There is Example in cfg).
- Restart the game.
- Rename your Card Linker on anvil into Bank_Name from myATM.cfg and place it.

![Example of Card Linker renaming](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/153b58d9555c24c1c03f73fc6d0807f5839d0f7d.png)

- Rename your Terminal into Bank_Name=Account_Number_From_Site (Example: GLTest=39576316) and place it.

![Example of Terminal renaming](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/e8e4298f8fa7006d55f0b9e01fc87331370d1068.png)

- Profit

### How to use:
- Create account on site.
- Put blank card into ATM.

![Prepare to link](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/a7ec74b984b46bdd82ab8c010128bacc2e734bd9.png)

- Use you account data (Login and Password) and create PIN in ATM. It create card, linked to your account.

![Linked card](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/51129d4a77295e7d9ac2a505b889ce7b8a4b8f2a.png)

- Put your card in Terminal.

![Ready to pay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/908508ff5db89a3dc78bbf7128e2b960c4cfec88.png)

- Enter amount and PIN to pay.

![Payment done](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/15e6212276a1b12065d0b253182fae1109f92dcd.png)

- How it looks on example site

![Example site after payment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SkS98dyX/images/e1d8f44eadb3c47a84d85a43c5236b91d176d7ca.png)

### In latest release:
- Multiple banks support. (add new lines with 'bank_name':'site_link':'api_password' in myATM.cfg)
- Simple and fast in-game payment.
- Improved block textures.
- Replace green text in Terminal with in-GUI light signal.

### Soon:
- Simplified addition of new currencies (currently only through code changes).
- Multiple cards on account.
- Clear separation of cards from different banks
- Depositing and withdrawing cash from an ATM
